verdict.rationale: Isaac Lab ships its own first-party library of agent skills covering installation, environment creation, RL training and migration. Isaac ROS documents a dedicated AI agent skill for upgrading ROS 2 nodes. Together these let a user drive key workflows through natural-language instructions to an AI agent, but the documentation is thin and limited to these specific tasks. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the simulator itself (scene building, robot control, stepping), documentation of how the skills behave, any hands-on or independent corroboration, and coverage across Isaac Sim and GR00T.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Isaac Lab ships a library of agent skills for installation, environment creation, RL training, migration, and more.
use a dedicated AI agent skill to upgrade an existing NVIDIA CUDA™-accelerated ROS 2 node for efficient memory transport.
